__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’)
__broaden__.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’)
__broaden__.βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’
__broaden__.βίης: βίη — might, force; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation with σχέσθαι ’hold back from force’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of μνησαμένοις: ’of the might’ (Κύκλωπός τε βίης ’the Cyclops’ might’)
__broaden__.δακρυόφιν: δάκρυον (by-form δάκρυ) — tear; neut. gen./abl. with the epic suffix -φιν (number not marked), marking separation: ’dry of tears’ (with τέρσομαι) · also instrumental, ’with tears’ (δακρυόφιν πίμπλαντο ’were filled with tears’)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’)
__broaden__.κλαῖον: κλαίω — weep, wail; impf. 1 sg. · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιον): ’they wept’
__broaden__.λίπ: λίπα — richly, thickly; adv. (perh. instead an elided case-form of a noun ’fat’, cf. λίπος), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα) · also λείπω — leave; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (λίπ’ = λίπε): ’leave (me)’
__broaden__.πάρ: παρά — beside, along; prep. + dat., epic apocope πάρ (= παρά) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε ’threw beside’)
__broaden__.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’)
__broaden__.πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’) · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
__broaden__.τετυγμένα: τεύχω — make, fashion; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. pl.: ’wrought, well-made’, agreeing with ἄγγεα · also agreeing with δώματα: ’well-wrought’ (τετυγμένα δώματα ’well-wrought halls’)
__broaden__.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
__broaden__.χλωρὸν: χλωρός — green, fresh (of living wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also of honey, neut. acc. sg.: ’yellow, pale’ (μέλι χλωρόν ’yellow honey’)
__broaden__.ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
__broaden__.ἐυκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved; masc. acc. pl., epithet of the Achaeans · also of Odysseus’ companions (ἐυκνήμιδας ἑταίρους ’well-greaved companions’)
__broaden__.ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., predicate · also masc. nom. sg., predicate (νοῦς … ἔμπεδος ’the mind was steady’)
__broaden__.ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’ · also dual dat.: ’on the shoulders’ (ὤμοιιν βαλόμην ’I slung on my shoulders’)
__broaden__.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
__broaden__.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)
